title: National Commission must call for records and pass orders
description: The National Commission has jurisdiction to call for records and pass orders in certain consumer disputes

content.what: must call for records and pass appropriate orders
conditions: consumer dispute pending before or decided by State Commission
State Commission has exercised jurisdiction not vested in it by law, or failed to exercise jurisdiction, or acted illegally or with material irregularity
limitations: value of goods or services paid as consideration exceeds rupees ten crore
